svg.title: Per-example clipping changes the average matrix
svg.desc: Deterministic teaching example with clipping threshold C equal to 1. G1 is [[4, 0], [0, 0]], has Frobenius norm 4, and receives weight 1/4. G2 is [[0, 1], [0, 1]], has norm square root of 2, and receives weight 1 divided by square root of 2. Their original mean A is [[2, 0.5], [0, 0.5]]. Their clipped mean B is [[0.5, 0.353553...], [0, 0.353553...]], shown rounded to three decimal places. These are illustrative matrices, not measured training results.
